notes.text: Client has submitted their documents for review.

Dear Zarika & the BUILD X Team,

Thank you for your patience and for following up regarding the Annual Financial Statements. We have completed a comprehensive compliance audit of Order #10072 and wish to directly address your query regarding the company registration number:

1. **Definitive Resolution of Registration Number Flag:**
• Our automated intake check previously triggered a false mismatch flag because the Compensation Fund (COIDA) reference number (**990000235838**) was incorrectly cross-referenced against the CIPC company registration field.
• We have audited the full record and confirm that **2000/027067/23** is indeed the 100% correct and verified CIPC Close Corporation registration number for **BUILD X HARDWARE AND BUILDWARE CC**, while **CF990000235838** is the correct Compensation Fund reference number.
• The false mismatch flag has been permanently cleared in our audit record.

2. **Compliance Audit Status — All Documents Approved (8/8):**
• **Annual Financial Statements (Year Ended 28 Feb 2025):** Fully verified and APPROVED. Confirmed signed by Member Clyle Kemm (Page 5) and Compiler Zarika Lubbe (Page 7), initialled on all 23 pages, reflecting principal business activity as *"Retail Services and Supply of goods"*.
• **CIPC CK2 Documentation:** Fully verified and APPROVED (Close Corporation in Business, Clyle Kemm 100% member).
• **Signed Instruction Letter (Dated 11 Aug 2026):** Fully verified and APPROVED (signed by Clyle Kemm requesting reclassification to Subclass 0710).
• **Business Operation Site Photos (10 Photos):** Fully verified and APPROVED (conclusively demonstrating retail hardware, paint, plumbing, yard, and delivery fleet operations).
• **Proof of Address (ABSA Bank Statement):** Fully verified and APPROVED.

3. **Pending Client Action to Finalize Lodgement:**
All background document verifications are complete. To allow us to submit the formal application dossier to the Compensation Commissioner, we require the signed statutory forms:
• **Form CF-1B (Application for Change of Nature of Business):** Please have Clyle Kemm sign and date **Page 3** under the *"Employer Representative / Delegated Official / Employer"* section.
• **Special Power of Attorney:** Please have Clyle Kemm sign and date at the bottom signature line authorizing Kevin Freese (CIBA CBAP SA #3561) to represent the entity.

**Download Links:**
• [Download Form CF-1B (Application Form)](https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/studio-2604127518-57889.firebasestorage.app/o/orders%2F10072%2Fgenerated_drafts%2FCOIDA_CF1B_Application_Form_BUILD_X_10072.pdf?alt=media)
• [Download Special Power of Attorney](https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/studio-2604127518-57889.firebasestorage.app/o/orders%2F10072%2Fgenerated_drafts%2FPower_of_Attorney_COIDA_Kevin_Freese_BUILD_X_10072.pdf?alt=media)

Please upload the signed copies here in your Communication History. As soon as the signed pages are received, we will immediately lodge the complete dossier with the Compensation Fund and track the reclassification to secure your revised industry assessment and Letter of Good Standing.
